{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Leather armor''' is the lightest armor, crafted from [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]] (dropped by [[Zombie|zombies]]). Every piece adds safe fall distance. The pieces are the [[Leather Hood|hood]], [[Leather Pauldron|pauldron]], [[Leather Pants|pants]] and [[Leather Boots|boots]].

== Obtaining ==
The vanilla recipes are replaced; the same shapes use tattered leather instead of leather. The armor is repaired with [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. The boots have Feather Falling II.
